title: Richards Quantitative Temporal-Error Readiness & Owner Boundary

measured.nonzero_cases: finite h and theta component maxima in all four perturbed cases

what_the_measurement_establishes: The current binary Richards comparator throws away a finite graded full-step versus two-half-step state discrepancy on physically evolving cases.
Retry halving does not produce a robust monotone h/theta discrepancy sequence for the exact qualified nonzero probe.
The current three-scale ladder is characterization evidence, not proof of an asymptotic temporal-error law.
No ponding, groundwater or optional-state discrepancy semantics can be inferred from this inactive/zero-delta profile.
why_no_metric_is_selected: The measured pressure-head discrepancies overlap the scale of the configured nonlinear head stopping criterion at approximately -75 cm, so temporal truncation is not separated from nonlinear stopping/arithmetic/route effects.
No qualified formal temporal order or Richardson step-doubling factor was found for the admitted Richards path.
Apparent order inferred diagnostically from successive discrepancy ratios is unstable and becomes negative on the second halving for the +/-1e-11 cases.
The artifact contains only component maxima, not nodewise spatial patterns or dz-weighted signed theta storage-state differences.
The characterization-only relative h/theta normalizations were invented solely for observation and have no source/theory basis for production use.
Combining head and water content into one scalar would therefore require an arbitrary normalization that F-MR16 explicitly does not admit.

pressure_head_candidate_assessment.basis: HeadCalc's nonlinear convergence is directly expressed in pressure head, and theta is constitutively updated from pressure head on this route.
pressure_head_candidate_assessment.missing: temporal-order contract, solver-floor separation, qualified tolerance semantics, active-state coverage and broader convergence evidence

current_binary_comparator_assessment.reason: F-MR16 found implementation evidence for exact identity but no source/theory evidence that bitwise/exact final-state identity is the intended temporal-accuracy criterion for physically evolving Richards solutions. F-VQ19 SNOW identity semantics are not generalized to Richards.

exact_missing_evidence: F-SI model-owner theory/source statement for the admitted Richards time discretization and temporal-error observable.
Evidence separating temporal discrepancy from nonlinear solver stopping tolerance while physics and forcing remain unchanged.
An extended dt ladder sufficient to establish or refute the intended asymptotic regime.
Nodewise signed/absolute h and theta difference vectors and spatial/max-location diagnostics.
If theta/storage is used, a signed dz-weighted state-storage discrepancy that remains distinct from the authoritative mass gate.
Explicit semantics and qualification for ponding, groundwater level and optional process state, or a justified conditional exclusion contract.
Source/theory evidence for any normalization or scalarization across unlike dimensions.
Deterministic model-owned metric evaluation and independent scientific qualification after implementation.

ownership_chain.F_KT: unchanged generic checkpoint/retry/rollback/commit and scalar temporal_error <= temporal_tolerance contract
ownership_chain.F_SI: next production owner for Richards-specific temporal-error semantics
ownership_chain.F_MR: future composition owner after F-SI qualification
ownership_chain.F_PE: may consume an accepted nontrivial Richards runtime only after that chain; owns later cost thresholds/policies

next_action: Open an F-SI/model-owner workunit for Richards temporal-error theory, metric semantics and qualification. Do not modify production temporal acceptance in F-MR16 and do not resume F-PE reference-tail/bounded-cost qualification yet.
